cases.title: FM services in EMEA — well-defined category, geography, and time horizon

inputs.category: Integrated facilities management — cleaning, security, catering

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
market structure section identifies at least 3 supplier segments
cost drivers are listed with at least 2 concrete drivers
source_quality fields populated (recency, coverage, bias_risk)
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
assumptions does not include unverified pricing figures presented as facts

cases.title: Category name only — no geography, no time horizon, no constraints
pass_signals: status is blocked or confidence_level is LOW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: geography not specified, time horizon not specified
skill does not proceed to produce a market scan without at minimum geography and category boundary
open_questions contains at least: geography, sub-category scope, time horizon
no supplier names presented as validated without evidence

cases.title: Global scope declared but EU-only supplier policy applies

constraints: EU-only supplier policy — no data residency outside EU
Global coverage of delivery locations required

pass_signals: conflict between global geography and EU-only supplier policy is explicitly surfaced
skill does not silently narrow to EU without flagging the contradiction
open_questions or risk_flags contains: geographic scope vs. supplier policy conflict
confidence_level is MEDIUM or LOW — not HIGH while contradiction is unresolved
no recommendation to proceed is issued until conflict is resolved

cases.title: Apparent monopoly market with regulatory scrutiny flagged

inputs.additional_context: Only one EASA-certified supplier identified after search. Buyer has indicated this is a renewal, not an open competition.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: apparent single-source market
risk_flags contains: safety-critical category requires override to strategic process
escalation_required is true
confidence_level is not HIGH — limited competition reduces reliability of market view
skill does not endorse a no-competition approach without surfacing the risk explicitly
data_gaps includes: market alternatives not independently verified
